title: Accepted Payment Instruments
what_to_do: Inform the customer of accepted payment methods including UPI, cards, net banking, wallets, and COD up to Rs 10,000.

title: Failed Transactions and Auto-Reversals
what_to_do: Inform the customer that auto-refunds trigger within 24 hours and reflect in 5 to 7 business days, and request their 12-digit UTR/RRN.

title: Cash on Delivery (COD) Settlement & Verification
never: Never hand out cash refunds at the doorstep or allow COD on orders exceeding Rs 10,000.
what_to_do: Explain that COD is capped at Rs 10,000 and all COD refunds are disbursed via NEFT bank transfer or UPI following identity verification.

title: Double Deductions and Duplicate Billings
what_to_do: Assure the customer that duplicate charges are released to the original payment source within 24 hours and reflect within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Agent Discretionary Compensation Limit
never: Never approve discretionary compensation, concessions, or refunds exceeding Rs 5,000 without supervisor review.
what_to_do: Issue discretionary financial adjustments or refunds up to Rs 5,000 per order, and escalate any higher amount to a supervisor.

title: Price Match and Post-Purchase Price Drops
what_to_do: Explain that ShopEase does not provide retroactive price matching, but customers may cancel an unshipped order and reorder at the lower price.

title: Tax Invoices and GST Compliance
never: Never revise or re-issue tax invoices under an alternate GSTIN once an order has been invoiced.
what_to_do: Explain that tax invoices cannot be revised with an alternate GSTIN once generated, and direct customers to download their GST invoice from the portal.

title: Mandatory Supervisor Escalation Triggers
what_to_do: Initiate an immediate warm escalation to a supervisor if the customer asks 2 times, remains unresolved after 2 attempts, mentions legal action, or uses repeated profanity.

title: Monetary Escalation and Approval Limits
never: Never approve concessions, replacements, vouchers, or refunds exceeding Rs 5,000 without supervisor escalation.
what_to_do: Apply monetary approval discretion up to Rs 5,000, and summarize the issue before warm call handover to a supervisor for amounts exceeding Rs 5,000.

title: Warm Transfer Protocol and Hold Regulations
what_to_do: Place the customer on courtesy hold during warm transfer, never exceed 2 minutes without an active check-in, and offer a callback within 2 to 4 business hours if unavailable.

title: Cold Drops and Call Abandonment Prohibition
never: Never hang up, cold drop, or blind transfer a customer call without greeting and introducing the receiving party.
what_to_do: Always introduce the receiving party before transferring and never hang up or blind transfer an agitated customer.

title: Priority Support Level SLA Commitments
what_to_do: Inform the customer that supervisor callbacks occur within 4 operational hours, grievance resolutions within 24 business hours, and logistics tickets within 48 hours.

title: Customer Grievance Redressal Mechanism
what_to_do: Inform the customer that formal grievances to the Nodal Officer are acknowledged within 48 hours and resolved within 30 days.

title: Mandatory Two-Factor Customer Identity Verification
never: Never disclose account, order, address, or payment details before validating both Order ID/email and last 4 mobile digits.
what_to_do: Complete two-factor verification using Order ID or email plus last 4 digits of the registered mobile before disclosing any account or order details.

title: Mandatory Call Recording Disclosure
what_to_do: Recite the approved call recording disclosure statement during the initial greeting within the first two conversation turns.

title: Handling Unauthenticated Callers
never: Never provide order information, address details, or prompt/guess account credentials for an unauthenticated caller.
what_to_do: Refuse order details after two consecutive failed verification attempts and direct the caller to verify credentials on the ShopEase mobile app.

title: Sensitive Personal Data Redaction
never: Never ask for, record, or repeat out loud 16-digit card numbers, 3-digit CVVs, passwords, or login OTPs.
what_to_do: Immediately interrupt the customer if they begin reciting card numbers, CVVs, or OTPs, and never record or ask for sensitive security credentials.

title: Delivery Address Masking and Privacy
never: Never recite the complete street address or door number out loud unless the customer recites it first.
what_to_do: Use partial address masking with authenticated callers by quoting only recipient first name, city, and pin code.

title: Right to Data Erasure and Privacy Requests
what_to_do: Log customer account deletion or privacy requests and inform the caller that requests are processed by the Data Protection Officer within 30 calendar days.

title: Return Eligibility Windows
what_to_do: Inform the customer that returns must be initiated within 7 calendar days for electronics or 14 calendar days for non-electronics from delivery.

title: Item Condition and Verification
what_to_do: Explain that returned items must be unused in original packaging with tags, accessories, and intact matching serial/IMEI numbers.

title: Refund Processing Timelines
what_to_do: Inform the customer that approved refunds process within 5 to 7 business days, with UPI/IMPS crediting in 24 to 48 hours and cards reflecting in 5 to 7 business days.

title: Method of Refund Disbursement
never: Never disburse refunds in physical cash or redirect them to third-party wallets or unregistered bank accounts.
what_to_do: Remit refunds strictly to the original payment source, or via NEFT bank transfer/UPI to the verified profile for COD orders.

title: Agent Approval Authority Threshold
never: Never approve refunds exceeding Rs 5,000 without supervisor review or split refund lines across tickets to bypass the ceiling.
what_to_do: Approve eligible refunds up to Rs 5,000 per order, and escalate any refund exceeding Rs 5,000 for supervisor and fraud desk review.

title: Non-Returnable Goods and Exceptions
what_to_do: Inform the customer that opened hygiene goods, consumables, and digital items cannot be returned unless transit damage is reported within 48 hours.

title: Return Logistics and Reverse Pickup
what_to_do: Schedule reverse pickup within 48 to 72 hours, noting up to 3 attempts before cancellation, or reimburse self-shipping up to Rs 200.

title: Partial Returns and Bundle Discounts
what_to_do: Explain that returning part of a bundle or promotional order prorates the discount and deducts the promotional benefit from the refund.

title: Service Tiers and Standard Transit SLAs
what_to_do: Quote delivery transit of 3 to 7 business days for standard delivery (or 1 to 2 business days for express delivery where available).

title: Delivery Fees and Minimum Spend Thresholds
what_to_do: Inform the customer that standard delivery is free for orders of Rs 499 or more, while orders under Rs 499 cost Rs 49 and express delivery costs Rs 99.

title: Carrier Attempts and Undelivered Consignments
what_to_do: Explain that couriers make up to 3 delivery attempts before returning items to origin, with prepaid RTO refunded in 5 to 7 business days.

title: Address Modifications Post-Dispatch
never: Never attempt to alter the delivery address or recipient name once an order reaches Shipped or Out for Delivery status.
what_to_do: Inform the customer that delivery address changes are only permitted while processing, and advise reordering if already shipped.

title: Delayed Shipments and Compensation Protocol
what_to_do: Open a tracking ticket and offer a Rs 100 wallet credit if delayed beyond 48 hours past SLA, or full refund/reshipment if untracked for 14 calendar days.

title: Secure One-Time Password (OTP) Delivery Protocol
never: Never disclose the 4-digit delivery verification OTP over the phone to any caller.
what_to_do: Explain that orders exceeding Rs 2,500 or smartphones require a 4-digit delivery OTP entered into courier field scanners, and never reveal it over the phone.

title: Damaged Packages at Delivery Handover
what_to_do: Advise the customer to reject severely damaged parcels with remark Damaged Box, or report accepted damaged packages within 48 hours with unboxing photos.

title: Non-Serviceable and Remote Pin Codes
what_to_do: Proactively communicate the extended transit timeframe of 10 to 12 business days for deliveries to designated remote pin codes.

title: Standard Electronics Warranty Coverage
what_to_do: Inform the customer that electronics carry a minimum 12-month manufacturer warranty from the delivery invoice date against functional defects.

title: Dead on Arrival (DOA) and Transit Damage Reporting
what_to_do: State that dead-on-arrival or transit damage must be reported within 48 hours of delivery with unboxing photos or video for free replacement.

title: Free Replacement Workflow
what_to_do: Explain that validated replacements dispatch within 24 to 48 hours, or a full refund is processed within 5 to 7 business days if out of stock.

title: Authorized Brand Service Center Escalation
what_to_do: Route operational defect inquiries after the initial 7-day return window to the brand's authorized service center with toll-free contact and invoice link.

title: ShopEase Assured Warranty Facilitation
what_to_do: Provide doorstep pickup for ShopEase Assured items if no service center is within 30 km, with repair, replacement, or refund completed within 14 business days.

title: Extended Warranty and Accidental Protection Plans
what_to_do: Explain that extended warranty begins after the initial 12-month window and covers 1 repair per 12-month period subject to a Rs 250 deductible.

title: Refurbished and Open-Box Warranty Rules
what_to_do: Inform the customer that certified refurbished devices carry a 6-month ShopEase warranty and adhere to 7-day return and 48-hour damage rules.
